content:
The fourth global coral bleaching event was confirmed on April 15, 2024. The satellite-measured heat-stress window, however, spans January 2023 through September 2025.

Across that period, bleaching-level heat stress covered roughly 84.4% of global reef area—up from 68.2% during the 2014–2017 event. Mass bleaching was documented in at least 83 countries and territories.

The record is about the extent of reef area exposed to bleaching-level heat stress. It does not mean that 84.4% of reefs were confirmed to have bleached or died.
